days_meaning: each delivery day adds this much cash to your side

messages.text: Hola, Rival Luna, voy con prisa: 68 por La Sala Pentagrama y cerramos ya. Entrega inmediata.
I can do 96 P with delivery in 10 days. Every round costs us both, so let's close.
Venga, 86; no tengo mucho tiempo. Entrega inmediata.
Thanks for moving. I can do 95 with 10 days delivery, a fair price for both of us.
